description:
Problem and evidence
lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex repeats confirmed receipt construction in execute_delivery_step/3 and send_reply_with_smtp/3: delivery_receipt(threading), confirmation, source_scope, delivery_conversation_id, and Incoming.Audience. Text and planned attachment submission should share this mapping.

Implementation
Extract one private confirmed_email_receipt(outgoing, threading, envelope) helper (or an equally clear name), and use it from both success paths. Keep attachment enrichment in email_attachment_receipt after common construction. Preserve the text sender's plain :ok compatibility branch and existing envelope validation. Do not merge submission paths or alter MIME encoding, selected connector, sender/recipients, threading, retries, telemetry, error handling, or history semantics.

Action reuse: extend existing delivery_receipt/1 and delivery_conversation_id/2 composition; no parallel receipt module or new public API.

Tests
Review test/zaq/channels/email_bridge_test.exs, email_bridge/outgoing_attachments_test.exs, email_file_delivery_integration_test.exs and email_html_delivery_test.exs. Retain text and attachment observable receipt assertions and SMTP rejection/no-fallback coverage. Delete only redundant implementation-specific tests or fixtures made obsolete by this extraction, if any; test deletion is not a quota. Acceptance: both paths use the same builder and existing public results remain unchanged.

Authorization and boundaries
User explicitly requested these four cleanup issues on 2026-11-20 and approved removing tests related to this cleanup. Remove tests/fixtures that exist solely for retired APIs, unreachable branches, or unsupported legacy report shapes. Migrate assertions for still-supported behavior to the retained production boundary; do not remove security, byte-integrity, history, callback, or delivery-policy coverage merely because its old entry point disappears. Record the exact deleted tests and retained/migrated coverage in completion notes. This approval does not authorize unrelated behavior changes, dependency publication, commit/push, or final UX/E2E acceptance.

Implementation guidance
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, and applicable naming/code-quality guidance. Read docs/documentation.md before updating stale API documentation. Recheck live callers and workspace changes before editing; review evidence was collected at f6a1d3070. No new Action or tool exposure is needed: this is local cleanup of existing Channel operations.

Validation and completion
Run focused affected existing suites and mix q per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Preserve meaningful existing properties; introduce no tests that merely mirror private helpers. Report failures honestly, including unrelated known failures. Final coverage and mix precommit remain under zaq-1lw.13. This issue blocks architecture review zaq-1lw.12; sibling cleanups have no semantic dependency. Coordinate edits with other workers.

comments.text: Action reuse assessment: local-only shared confirmed receipt builder in EmailBridge, composing existing delivery_receipt/1 and delivery_conversation_id/2. Consumers are text SMTP submission and executor single-email submission; no public Action or tool exposure. Envelope, selected connector, audience, threading, errors and history remain unchanged. Workspace initially clean at f6a1d3070. Existing focused email suites retain observable receipt and rejection coverage. User approved in-scope test cleanup; none expected for extraction.

Implementation complete in working tree: both success paths share confirmed_email_receipt/3; attachment enrichment and text :ok compatibility retained. Focused four email suites: 111 passed (2 properties, 109 tests); mix q passed (format, hooks, Credo, docs). No tests or fixtures removed: existing public receipt, MIME, SMTP rejection/no-fallback coverage remains relevant. No commit/push; final coverage/precommit remain zaq-1lw.13; pending integration review/landing.

User authorized commit and push. All four cleanups committed together as a6405a766 (refactor(channels): remove obsolete delivery paths (zaq-1lw)) and pushed to origin/feat/channel-files. Pre-commit qf and commit-message hooks passed; pre-push format hook passed. Working tree clean and HEAD matches remote. Focused validation and test removal mappings remain in prior notes. Architecture review/final coverage/precommit gates remain in .12/.13; no merge performed.
